login.subtitle: Sign in to your team board.
login.forgotHelp: Contact your team admin to reset your password.

reset.requestSubtitle: Enter your account email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
reset.sentBody: If an account exists for {{email}}, we've sent a link to reset your password. It expires in 1 hour.
reset.successBody: You can now sign in with your new password.
reset.expiredBody: Password reset links are valid for 1 hour. Please request a new one.
reset.genericError: Something went wrong. Please request a new link.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: Set up your team on Ananda Taskboard.
signup.name: Your name
signup.error: Could not create the account. Please try again.
signup.checkBody: We've sent a verification link to {{email}}. Click it to activate your account and team.

verify.okBody: Your account and team are active. You can now sign in.

platform.title: Platform overview
platform.subtitle: Metadata only — task contents stay private to each organization.

task.name: Task name
task.monitor: Monitor — notify admins when this task is moved
task.autoComplete: Auto-complete — mark Done automatically after the deadline

bulk.title: Bulk migrate tasks
bulk.intro: Filter, tick the tasks to change, then apply one transition at a time. Admin-only; changes are immediate.
bulk.error: Could not apply — check the value.

approvals.intro: Tasks members created that need your OK before they appear on the board. Tick rows to bulk-approve, click Open to see full details, or approve/reject each.

trash.intro: Deleted items are kept for 7 days, then removed automatically. Restore brings an item (and anything deleted with it) back.
trash.confirmPurge: Delete forever? This cannot be undone.

restore.intro: Full snapshots of the whole board. Restoring auto-saves the current state first (so it's undoable). Auto-saves happen daily (last 10 kept); manual saves stay forever.
restore.confirmRestore:
Restore to "{{name}}"?

This first auto-saves the current board, then replaces ALL data with this snapshot.
restore.confirmDelete: Delete restore point "{{name}}"? (The board itself is unaffected.)

history.intro: An accurate snapshot of who was assigned to what on a given day (recorded daily). History builds up from today forward.
history.none: No snapshot stored for {{day}}. (History records daily, starting from when the feature went live.)

settings.saveErr: Could not save — check the values.
settings.statusesTitle: Task statuses (Kanban columns — apply to all projects)
settings.pushTimeHelp: Determines the "today" boundary for the morning push. Exact send time is set by the daily scheduler (see deploy runbook); set the scheduler to match this hour.
settings.statusesHelp: Rename, recolor, reorder, or add columns. Tick "complete" for the Done state (drives auto-archiving + hiding from calendars).
settings.eventsHelp: Shown as bars on the Weekly & Monthly calendars. Use a date range for a multi-day event, or Repeating for a weekly series (e.g. every Sat & Sun for 4 weeks).
settings.confirmDeleteStatus: Delete status "{{name}}"? Tasks in it will keep the value but show greyed.
settings.errDateTitle: A date and a title are required.
settings.errEndDate: Pick an end date for the range.
settings.errUntil: Pick an until-date, or choose a different end option.
settings.errSave: Could not save — check the fields.

mp.trustedTitle: Members can post tasks here without admin approval
mp.markDoneConfirm: Mark ALL tasks in "{{name}}" as Done and archive them? This can't be auto-undone.
mp.cantDeleteDefault: The default 'General' sub-project can't be deleted.

kanban.moveErr: You can only move tasks assigned to you (or be an admin).

del.title: Delete {{kind}}: {{name}}
del.noTasks: This {{kind}} has no tasks. Deleting moves it to Trash (restorable for 7 days).
del.hasTasks: This {{kind}} has {{count}} task(s). Tick the ones to move to another sub-project; un-ticked tasks go to Trash with the {{kind}} (restorable 7 days).

ap.noAccessTitle: No access to the selected sub-project

import.intro: Paste rows copied from a spreadsheet (including the header row), or upload a CSV / TSV / JSON / Excel file. Rows are matched to existing tasks by the ID column; rows without a known ID create new tasks. Missing projects/sub-projects are created automatically.
import.overwriteWarn: ⚠ Rows with a matching ID will overwrite the existing task. Switch any to "Create new" or "Skip" below.

export.whatToExportHint: (leave all unchecked = everything you can see)
export.copyTitle: Copy as TSV — paste straight into a Google Sheet

tm.errStatus: You can't change this task's status.
tm.errTimes: Set both a start and end time, or neither.
tm.errEndTime: End time must be after the start time.
tm.errPerm: You don't have permission to do that.
tm.startDateInfo: If left blank and a deadline is set, the task shows on the calendar from its creation date up to the deadline.
tm.startTimeInfo: Optional. Set both times for a timed task (e.g. a class 1pm–4pm). Timed tasks sort to the top of a day's list.

ta.name: Name
ta.shareHint: Share the email + password with them directly. Admins ignore tiers — they see everything.
ta.errAddMember: Could not add — check email is unique and password ≥ 8 chars.
ta.confirmDeleteTier: Delete tier "{{name}}"? Members on it keep their own grants but lose the tier's.
ta.tiersHelp: Reusable permission templates. A member assigned to a tier inherits its grants + exclusions live. Set a tier's grants and exclusions in the Access tab (subject = Tier).
ta.activityHelp: Recent permission & visibility changes — who changed what, and when. Read-only.
ta.errPickSubjectScope: Pick a subject and a scope.
ta.errAddGrant: Could not add grant (maybe it already exists).
ta.errPickExclude: Pick or enter what to exclude.
ta.errAddExclusion: Could not add exclusion (maybe it already exists).
ta.accessHelp: Pick a subject; grants + exclusions work the same for a Person, Group, or Tier. Effective access stacks tier → group → individual, then exclusions remove. Deny > assignment > allow.
ta.selectSubjectEmpty: Select a person, group, or tier to manage their access.
ta.ownHint: "Own" = the member is an assignee, or one of their groups is.
ta.noGrants: No grants yet for this subject.
ta.exclusionsTitle: Exclusions — hide specific things from this subject
ta.exclusionsHelp: A deny always wins, even over a task the member is assigned to (deny > assignment > allow). Use sparingly.
